description: List the runs of one scrape job, newest first: when each ran, its status and the prices it found. Hosted scraping is behind a release flag: until it is on for your workspace this answers 501 hosted_scraping_not_enabled. Runs honour robots.txt and fetch only public https pages. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce:catalog:read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

job_id.description: The scrape job UUID: id on a list_scrape_jobs result.

limit.description: Most runs to return. Defaults to 20.

name: list_scrape_job_runs
